1.web: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
1.asv: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.

2.web: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem;
2.asv: Our feet are standing Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,

3.web: Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together;
3.asv: Jerusalem, that art builded As a city that is compact together;

4.web: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
4.asv: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, Foran ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.

5.web: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
5.asv: For there are set thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.

6.web: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
6.asv: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.

7.web: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
7.asv: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.

8.web: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
8.asv: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

9.web: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.
9.asv: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.
